data_section_full_text:
Sample selection and data sources

Data

Our sample is restricted to Taiwanese listed companies audited by the Big 4 firms
from 1990 to 2004. <sup>19</sup> Financial data, audit firm data, signing auditor names data,
and accounting restatements were obtained from the Taiwan Economic Journal
(TEJ) database. Our sample period starts in 1990 because the SELER were passed
in mid-1989 and became effective in 1990.

Table 1, panel A summarizes the sample selection process. There are 605
accounting restatements during our sample period. First, we exclude 58 observations audited by non–Big 4 firms because our sample is restricted to companies
audited by Big 4 firms. Second, we delete 15 restatement observations because the
audit firm’s name was missing. To meet our restatements criteria, as described
above, we further eliminate 20 observations from our sample due to required and
routine revisions of prior results, such as discontinued operations. We also exclude
27 and 135 observations from our sample due to the accounting changes and
changes in reporting entity, respectively. Finally, we eliminate 24 restatement
